title: 生化学
subtitle: Biochemistry
teachers:
ODA Shinobu
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1) structures, classifications, and properties of biomaterials, such as glycans, lipids, and amino acids.
(2) biosynthesis and metabolism of the biomaterials.
(3) enzymatic reactions based on stereochemistry,
advice:
Biochemistry of glycans, lipids, and amino acids is very important to the pharmaceutial, food, and chemical industries. In this course, reactions and the mechanisms of enzymes and coenzymes will be presented first. Then, structures, classifications, properties, metabolism, and biosyntheses of glycans, lipids, amino acids and proteins, and nucleotides will be studied.
   Students will aquire the basic knowledge necessary to apply the use of biochemistry in future professional work.

Ability to understand and explain structures, properties, biosynthesis, and metabolism of glycans
Ability to understand and explain structures, properties, biosynthesis, and metabolism of lipids
Ability to understand and explain structures, properties, biosynthesis, and metabolism of amino acids

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully explain the structures, classifications, properties, reaction mechanism, and inhibition mechanism of enzymes.
(2) Fully explain the structures, classifications, properties, biosynthesis and metabolism of glycans.
(3) Fully explain the structures, classifications, properties, biosynthesis and metabolism of lipids.
(4) Fully explain the structures, classifications, properties biosynthesis and metabolism of amino acids.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Moderately explain the structures, classifications, properties, reaction mechanism, and inhibition mechanism of enzymes.
(2) Moderately explain the structures, classification, properties, biosynthesis and metabolism of glycans.
(3) Moderately explain the structures, classifications, properties, biosynthesis and metabolism of lipids.
(4) Moderately explain the structures, classifications, properties, biosynthesis and metabolism of amino acids.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

                 Biochemistry of glycans, lipids, and amino acids is very important to the pharmaceutial, food, and chemical industries. In this course, reactions and the mechanisms of enzymes and coenzymes will be presented first. Then, structures, classifications, properties, metabolism, and biosyntheses of glycans, lipids, amino acids and proteins, and nucleotides will be studied.
   Students will aquire the basic knowledge necessary to apply the use of biochemistry in future professional work.
